_schema: mchatai-source/verbs/ios/_capabilities.json — the Swift atoms the iOS app implements (Shared/OnDeviceAgent/AgentCapabilityRegistry.swift), one record each. A verb binds ONE capability (`capability`) or composes several (`steps`); content can never name one that is not here, and the app's drift test (AgentVerbCatalogTests) fails when this list and the Swift registry disagree. `safetyClass`: read < write < dangerous; a verb must declare at least the highest class of what it uses. `result` lists the fields a later step may bind as ${<step>.result.<field>}.

capabilities.summary: Searches one research source (a source pack or one of the person's own) and returns up to eight items.
Fetches one item's full record (title, authors, date, abstract, link) from the source it came from, or reads its page when the source has no item lookup.
Loads a web address and returns the page's title and visible text (a PDF address is read as a PDF).
Downloads a PDF and returns its text page by page, reading scanned pages with on-device OCR.
Summarizes text with the on-device model in the style asked for (notes, a paragraph, a spoken script) within a word budget.

styles.notes: Write short notes on the text: the main points as a Markdown bullet list, in plain words, using only what the text says.
styles.paragraph: Write one clear paragraph that says what the text is and what it concludes, using only what the text says.
styles.script: Write a spoken script about the text in plain sentences, to be read aloud: no headings, no Markdown, no lists, using only what the text says.

capabilities.summary: Creates a document in AI Write on this device and returns its id and link.
Returns an AI Write document's title and text by its id or title; on a miss, lists the closest titles instead of failing (invariant R2).
Reads a script aloud with the system voice and saves it as an episode in the Podcasts library on this device.
Transcribes an audio file on this device with Apple's on-device speech model in the language given.
